why: Turns the population from every modifier into a list of the modifiers someone judged to be states, which is the failure mode the sweep is shaped to avoid: a new state joins by omission and is never swept. The list here is generous on purpose -- it still contains the five modifiers the allowlist names -- so the mutation is killed only by the allowlist's own both-directions check noticing that entries it holds have silently left the population, not by a state disappearing. That is the assertion doing the work a narrower population would have lost.
killedBy: hud.css: no state is carried by colour alone (issue #926) keeps the allowlist honest: every entry is still colour-only, and still reinforced
